title: Protocol for altering connexin hemichannel function in primary chicken lens fiber cells using high-titer retroviral RCAS(A) infection
protocol: Add 10 μL of RCAS(A) virus (∼1–10 × 10^6 CFU/mL) concentrate containing vehicle, Cx50 WT, or Cx50 H156N to cultured primary chicken lens cells on 12-well plates or 60-mm dishes.
Replace with fresh complete medium of primary lens cells on the second day before subsequent experiments.
Treat primary lens fiber cells with forskolin at a concentration of 1 μM for 2 hours in a 60 mm dish containing a 40 mm cell culture slide.
Collect the culture medium from the treated cells into another tube for later use.
Do not include figures or links; therefore, the instrument setup details are excluded.
Check the airtightness of the FCS2/FCS3 system.
Clean the FCS2/FCS3 system with 70% alcohol for 0.5 hours.
Wash the FCS2/FCS3 system with ddH2O three times, each time for 10 minutes.
Preheat 125 mL of FFSS loading buffer in a constant temperature water bath at 37°C.
Assemble the FCS2/FCS3 system.
Clamp the liquid outflow rubber tube and the balance air rubber tube.
Rinse the FCS2/FCS3 system with RM to remove air bubbles at high flow rate.
Adjust the flow rate by loosening the clamped rubber tubes to 14 mL/min.
Unscrew the cell booster chamber clockwise, removing it from the FCS2/FCS3 system.
Place a 60 mm dish containing cells onto an FCS2/FCS3 40 mm cell culture slide and insert it into the cell booster chamber.
Tighten the cell booster chamber securely.
Connect the rubber tubes at both ends to the cell booster chamber.
Loosen the clamped rubber tubes to operate the system normally.
Tap the upper end of the cell force chamber gently to expel air bubbles.
Load cells with FFSS for 30 minutes.
Incubate primary lens fiber cells with GSH in a cell culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 using 200 μL of 1 mM GSH for 10 minutes.
Wash cells three times with RM at room temperature, 5 minutes each time.
Add previously collected and preserved cell culture medium (37°C) to the cells.
Treat lens primary fiber cells with 50 μM H2O2 for 4 hours, adding it to the side of the cell culture dish and gently mixing.
Wash cells three times with DPBS at room temperature, 5 minutes each time.
Detect cell apoptosis and necrosis using Dead Cell Apoptosis Kit on day 24, timing 1 hour.
Wash cells twice with cold BioLegend’s Cell Staining Buffer.
Prepare FITC-Annexin V and PI mixed solution, 230 μL per lens primary fiber cell sample (200 μL Annexin V Binding Buffer, 10 μL Annexin V, 20 μL PI).
Add 230 μL of FITC-Annexin V and PI mixed solution to the cells and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells three times with cold DPBS, 5 minutes each time.
Capture at least five microphotographs of fluorescence fields by a fluorescence microscope (Keyence BZ-X710) with a FITC and rhodamine filter.
